field_rules.activation_base_commit: exact 40-lowercase-hex commit at branch HEAD immediately before cutover-record persistence
field_rules.activation_contract_blob: must equal exact qualified activation-contract blob

forward_cutover_definition.immutable_identity: the exact Git blob of the cutover record plus the first governed-branch commit that introduces that exact blob at the fixed path
forward_cutover_definition.effective_cutover_rule: effective cutover time is the later of record.cutover_utc and the committed_at timestamp of the first governed-branch commit introducing the exact cutover blob
forward_cutover_definition.equality_rule: occurred_at_utc equal to the effective cutover second is not forward-eligible
forward_cutover_definition.retroactivity_rule: no event with occurred_at_utc <= effective cutover time may enter the forward pilot; such an event is historical/backfill territory

canonical_registry_surface.canonical_segment_definition: segment file reachable from governed branch HEAD at the exact segment_root and passing the frozen MCEPR validator
canonical_registry_surface.append_only_repository_rule: every previously canonical segment path and blob must remain present byte-identically at every later governed MCEPR state

genesis_rule.prerequisite: qualified immutable forward cutover record already canonical
genesis_rule.exact_payload_shape: exactly one real forward-eligible event and zero relations
genesis_rule.rationale: separate event/genesis mechanics from relation temporality and avoid manufacturing data merely to initialize the chain

all_required: event occurred strictly after effective cutover time
event was not created solely to initialize MCEPR
event is materially relevant to research provenance or research-evidence handling
event fields are truthfully populated under the frozen event schema
all decisive references required by the event resolve
when consultation_intensity is asserted, applicable 04 §4.6 traceability/evidence rules are satisfied
event and candidate segment validate under the exact qualified MCEPR implementation and frozen breaker surface
human approves the exact candidate segment blob before canonical append
prohibited: retroactively relabeling a pre-cutover event as forward
using missing registry history as evidence that no prior exposure occurred
using a registry event as scientific or operational authority

relation_activation_boundary.reason: relation records have no intrinsic occurred_at_utc; allowing them in the initial forward pilot could silently collapse historical/backfill relations into forward population
relation_activation_boundary.first_real_relation_next_step: requires a separate relation-temporality/admissibility authorization after the forward event pilot

manual_pilot.qualification_rule: at least 3 consecutive successful canonical append cycles after the last material activation-protocol correction; if this cannot be achieved within 5 authorized cycles, pilot status is BLOCKED pending human review

append_protocol: fetch/revalidate fresh governed branch HEAD and TREE
verify activation contract, cutover record, implementation and breaker identities
reject unknown files, prior deletions, prior rewrites, invalid segments, multiple genesis, forks or unresolved chain
derive unique current MCEPR head from full validated chain; for genesis require no canonical segment
construct exactly one candidate segment with zero relations
validate complete prior chain plus candidate
compute exact candidate segment blob and obtain human approval bound to that blob
re-fetch governed branch immediately before persistence
if MCEPR semantic state changed, BLOCKED and rebuild/reapprove
if only unrelated repository state changed and all bound MCEPR identities/refs remain exact, rebuild Git tree on fresh HEAD while preserving the exact approved segment blob
post-persistence fetch exact branch HEAD and re-enumerate/replay complete MCEPR chain
require candidate blob reachable at exact canonical path and unique derived head
persist append evidence only if separately authorized by the append action

concurrency_rules.git_head_changed_mcepr_unchanged: candidate segment blob may remain approved only after fresh revalidation proves cutover blob, contract blob, implementation blob, breaker blob, prior canonical segment set and every decisive reference used by the candidate remain unchanged/resolvable
concurrency_rules.mcepr_head_changed: BLOCKED; candidate parent and REGISTRY_ID are stale; rebuild and require new exact human approval
concurrency_rules.concurrent_mcepr_writers: no automatic merge, no automatic winner selection

failure_semantics.PASS: declared activation/append checks satisfied within the governed technical surface only
failure_semantics.FAIL: intrinsic deterministic violation of the frozen event/segment/activation rules
failure_semantics.BLOCKED: safe append or activation conclusion unavailable because authority, cutover, canonical chain, external reference resolution, concurrency state or repository continuity is ambiguous/missing

post_pilot_boundaries.first_real_relation: requires separate temporality/admissibility contract or equivalent governed decision
post_pilot_boundaries.runtime_integration: not justified by this activation contract

adversarial_review_cases: synthetic event created only to obtain genesis
event occurred in same whole second as effective cutover
orphan Git object treated as canonical cutover or segment
prior canonical segment deleted from current branch
prior canonical segment rewritten under same path
unrelated SFE commit changes Git HEAD but not MCEPR state
MCEPR head changes after human candidate approval
two MCEPR writers create children of same parent
relation inserted into initial event-only pilot
missing relation record interpreted as no influence
three successful cycles used to claim completeness
pilot cannot reach 3 consecutive successes within 5 cycles
bulk batch of multiple real events in one pilot segment
automatic producer starts after pilot without separate qualification
historical backfill begins after pilot without separate contract

next_frontier_after_documentary_qualific.note: cutover creation is not registry population and must occur before waiting for the first forward event
